questions.stem: A user says server-07 cannot reach customer-app-vpc. On a fresh released lab, the named VPC lookup prints nothing and the matching VPCAttachment list is empty. What is the best next action?

options.text: Restart the fabric controller because the webhook must have rejected the VPC
Request the intended manifests and the kubectl apply result or ArgoCD sync history
Change the switch port to VLAN 1020

questions.stem: All Agents show APPLIEDG equal to CURRENTG, and leaf-03/E1/3 reports oper up. What do these observations establish?

options.text: The reported VPC exists and server-07 has a DHCP lease
The server can ping its VPC gateway
The current desired Agent generations applied and that switch port is operationally up

questions.stem: On fabric v0.96.2, querying .status.state.interfaces["E1/3"].vlans returns null. How should you interpret that result?

options.text: That VLAN list is not part of this Agent interface status; inspect the VPC/attachment specs and use a server-side test when the objects exist
No VLAN can be configured on the switch
The VLAN was silently reassigned by the VLANNamespace

questions.stem: The user claims a manually chosen VLAN 1025 was silently reassigned to 1020, but customer-app-vpc is absent. Which conclusion is supported on the released fabric?

options.text: A VLAN conflict is confirmed because Grafana shows E1/3 Up
The switch applied VLAN 1020 because APPLIEDG equals CURRENTG
An empty Kubernetes Events list proves the VLAN change succeeded
The claim is unverified; inspect the intended manifests and submission result, and do not assume automatic reassignment
